name: desktop
description: Shared desktop application principles for Electron and Tauri apps.

interface.longDescription: Use Eric Desktop in any desktop app, Electron or Tauri. It covers local storage and migrations, cross-service and cross-language contracts, treating local service data as server state in the renderer, navigation and external-link handling, and preferring framework or OS primitives.
defaultPrompt: Use $desktop for the shared desktop principles in this app.
